content_sections.heading: PDKV Assistant Professor Job Description
content_sections.text: Assistant Professor: Teach the respective courses and conduct course related examinations, exam duties, education related activities and office related work assigned by the Associate Dean and Education Branch. Assistant Professor Physical Education also has to conduct all NSS and sport activities (Full Time for 11 Months). Assistant Librarian: Handle all library related work, purchasing of books, etc. and work assigned by the Associate Dean and Education Branch (Full Time for 11 Months). CHB Teacher: Teach the respective course and conduct course related examinations (Clock Hour Basis).

content_sections.heading: PDKV Assistant Professor Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must provide one set of attested xerox copies along with original testimonials/documents for verification at the time of joining. If a candidate fails to provide the originals at joining, the appointment will be treated as cancelled and the next waitlisted candidate will be appointed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PDKV Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed proforma from the Recruitment tab on the official Dr. PDKV website, www.pdkv.ac.in. Fill in the proforma and sign the application. Submit the duly signed application in hard copy on a working day up to 13/10/2026, 5.00 PM. If shortlisted, attend the online interview on 19/10/2026 at 11.00 am onwards, as informed by Email/WhatsApp.

content_sections.heading: PDKV Assistant Professor Other Conditions
content_sections.text: No interview call letters will be sent to candidates. Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated by Email/WhatsApp about link, process and schedule of interview. The appointment will be on a purely temporary basis for the mentioned period for the post, and the incumbent shall not have any claim for regular appointment under Dr. PDKV, Akola. The term of appointment will be co-terminus with the filling of permanent posts or period of completion of tenure. The number of posts may vary at the discretion of the undersigned. The consent letter will stand terminated after completion of the respective mentioned period for that post from the date of appointment. If selected candidates do not deliver duties as per the requirement of the college, or in case of poor performance, the undersigned will terminate the candidate at any time before completion of the stipulated period. Selected candidates for the 11 month contractual posts must sign a bond on Rs. 100/- stamp paper at the time of joining, otherwise they will not be allowed to join duties. Mere selection does not mean that the order will be issued. Any type of canvassing will lead to cancellation of candidature.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Dr Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth Akola (PDKV) for various contractual positions in Yavatmal, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies available for Assistant Professor, Physical Education, and Assistant Librarian posts under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 13 October 2026 up to 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for PDKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted strictly through offline mode by downloading the proforma and sending the hard copy to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required minimum qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree such as M.Tech, MBA, M.P.Ed, M.Lib, M.Sc, or M.E. along with NET/SET/SLET or Ph.D. depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions offer a consolidated monthly salary up to ₹45,000 per month or ₹25,000 per month, or appropriate hourly rates based on the specific post requirements.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview scheduled for clock hour basis teachers?
faq.answer: The interview for Clock Hour Basis Teachers is scheduled to be conducted on 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application proforma?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the application proforma from the recruitment tab available on the official Dr. PDKV website at www.pdkv.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification released by Dr Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth Akola.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the candidates applying under this notification involves an online interview conducted by the university authorities.
